|l5=160 |l_convert = 60 |b1=20 |b2=30 |b3=40 |b4=90 |b5=140 |b_convert = 35 |essence = Dragon }} == Skins == {{Item Skins|Wise Dragon Helmet}} == Tips == * Wise Dragon armor with Necrotic Reforge allows for relatively high defense and health, while providing the same amount of effective {{Stat|int}} as [[Crystal Armor|Necrotic Crystal Armor]]. * '''Note:''' The Effective {{Stat|int}} is only the same as Necrotic Crystal Armor When the {{Fsb}} Is active. * It can be a good alternative to {{Item|Adaptive Armor}} for low-budget mages in the catacombs. * When paired with {{Item|Aspect of the End}}, players can gain massive boost to their mobility, before gaining access to more late-game sources of increasing the efficiency of the weapon's ability. * Pairing this armor set with a {{Lvl|100}} {{Epic}} or {{Item|Sheep Pet|rarity=Leg}} effectively gives the player the same {{stat|mana}} cost reduction as the pre-0.7.5 ability. * Due to its {{stat|intelligence}} being very good even without the set bonus, players seeking ability damage should swap the helmet with {{Item|Dark Goggles}} or its upgrades. == Notes == * Rather than reducing the {{stat|mana}} cost of items by {{green|33%}}, the reduction is exactly {{green|1/3}}. * This is the best armor set for abilities as the full set bonus effectively increases the Mana Pool by {{green|50%}} by lowering costs with {{green|1 third}} while keeping the cost of all [[Power Orbs]] down. *All abilities that reduce {{stat|Mana}} cost of items are multiplicative with each other, as additive stacking would allow them to become 0 or lower. ** However, it is possible to have negative cost with items that directly provide {{Stat|Mana}}, such as {{Item|Shadow Assassin Boots}} and {{Item|Sapphire Power Scroll}}. == Trivia == * This armor is one of the four Dragon Armors that has coloring similar to that of the main stat bonus. The light blue color of the armor is the same light blue color of the {{stat|int}} stat. The other three armors that have similar colors to their stats are [[Strong Dragon Armor]], [[Young Dragon Armor]], and [[Holy Dragon Armor]]. * If one applies the {{Reforge|Wise}} Reforge to the armor, it's name becomes '''Very Wise Dragon Armor'''. Other items with similar effect can be seen [[Reforging#Duplicate Prefixes|here]]. == Showcase == {{YouTube|nqpmY2khKAY|align=center|caption=Wise Dragon Armor Showcase}}
